newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures finish strongly higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures finish strongly higher.

text.p: Oct 1 - U.S. debt futures finished up strongly after extending gains in afternoon trade on talk the Fed's Greenspan did not see an immediate inflation risk. Traders cited an Australian Financial Review story quoting Aussie Treasurer Peter Costello as saying the Fed chief was "optimistic." One firm sold 3,000 Dec T-bonds late to pull Dec from high, traders said. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
